razao: Fast Downward Stone Soup 2023 is a highly robust, state-of-the-art portfolio of multiple planner configurations. It leverages finite-domain variables, advanced heuristics (including landmarks and causal-graph heuristics), and varied search techniques, making it extremely effective at maximizing coverage across a wide variety of domains, including challenging ones like Openstacks.
